profile_text.body:
Rackspace Technology is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in San Antonio, trading as RXT and registered with the SEC as Rackspace Technology, Inc. It describes itself as a cloud computing services pioneer that delivers multicloud solutions across apps, data, and security, and says it has helped customers move from hosting to cloud to enterprise AI.

On its own site the company positions itself around enterprise AI, describing a secure, regulated, compliant foundation intended to let customers run AI on AI-optimized hardware. It says its engineers embed in customer environments to build, deploy, and operate AI workloads in production, and that it assembles partners across models, platform, and infrastructure into a governed system for regulated environments. The site also cites customers in Financial Services, Healthcare, and Government, and quotes Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer at Seattle Children's Hospital.

The held record lists no products, lawsuits, or MCP servers for the company.
